### Set-up

-   Download the [w4-statistical-analysis](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1f6tcrHKieFqKqGIwFzc5cO1Tc0GaBUxm?usp=sharing). This folder contains the **R script template** and datasets to be used for this workshop.

### 1. Independent Samples t-test

-   State the null and alternative hypotheses.\
-   Specify the decision rule and significance level.\
-   Check assumptions: normality and homogeneity of variance.\
-   Compute the test statistic and p-value.\
-   Write the conclusion and interpretation.\
-   Create a visualization of the results.

### 4. Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test

-   State the null and alternative hypotheses.\

### 5. One-way ANOVA

-   State the null and alternative hypotheses.\
-   Specify the decision rule and significance level.\
-   Check assumptions: normality and homogeneity of variance.\
-   Compute the test statistic and p-value.\
-   Perform a post-hoc test (Tukey HSD).\
-   Write the conclusion and interpretation.\
-   Create a visualization of the results.

### 6. Kruskal-Wallis Test

-   State the null and alternative hypotheses.\
-   Specify the decision rule and significance level.\
-   Check assumptions: normality and homogeneity of variance.\
-   Compute the test statistic and p-value.\
-   Perform post-hoc tests (Dunn’s test).\
-   Write the conclusion and interpretation.\
-   Create a visualization of the results.
